title: Tomb Raider I-III Remastered Starring Lara Croft
notes: Played all the way through the first level of Tomb Raider II in fullscreen with modern graphics.
issues: The game doesn't run at a stable 60fps compared to when playing on any PC from the past decade, however I'm not sure if that's just a limit of the Macbook Neo. No in-game FPS counter and wasn't able to get the Steam FPS counter to display (just showed a black box). Classic graphics do seem to run more smoothly, but either way the game is perfectly playable.
